description: Returns how many filings were published in the Mercantile Registry gazette (BORME) per month or per year, for all of Spain or one province, since 2009: incorporations, dissolutions, extinctions, insolvencies, capital increases and reductions, address changes and mergers. Use it for questions such as "how many companies were created in Valencia in 2025?". Dissolutions and insolvencies are not comparable between provinces; use extinctions to measure closures.

from.description: First month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY). Default: 11 months before "to".

metrics.description: Comma-separated metrics: incorporations, dissolutions, extinctions, insolvencies, capital_increases, capital_reductions, address_changes, mergers. Default: all.

province.description: Province of the Mercantile Registry by name (e.g. MADRID, VALENCIA) or INE code (e.g. 28). Omit for all of Spain.

to.description: Last month (YYYY-MM) or year (YYYY). Default: current month.

name: get_borme_stats
title: Spanish company filing statistics
